title: Starlink seems to be working normally again in Ukraine
slides: Why did Starlink suddenly go quiet in Ukraine?
Connectivity dropped across multiple front-line sectors
Outages tracked to specific terminal firmware versions
Users can check their dish status for version locks
Watch for silent firmware rollouts, not announcements
thread_text:
1. The Night Starlink Went Silent

In early 2026, Ukrainian forces noticed their front-line Starlink terminals going dark simultaneously across multiple sectors. No official announcement was made.

2. Outages Hit Multiple Fronts

Connectivity dropped across several front-line sectors at once, suggesting a coordinated event rather than isolated failures. Troops reported losing drone feeds and command links.

3. Firmware Versions Under Scrutiny

Engineers traced the outages to specific terminal firmware versions. Devices running particular builds were locked out, while others kept working.

4. Check Your Dish Status Now

Users can verify whether their dish is affected by checking the terminal status page for version locks. A quick look reveals if your device is on the blocked list.

5. Watch for Silent Rollouts

Don't wait for public announcements. Monitor your firmware version directly — silent pushes are the real signal. Check your dish today.

Your Starlink dish may have been quietly locked out — and it's working again now. 📡

Engineers traced the outages to specific firmware versions: some builds were blocked, others kept running. 🔍

If you depend on satellite links for field reporting or live feeds, check your dish status page for version locks before your next deployment.
